# braintrust_project_group (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up a Braintrust project group by organization ID and name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "org_id" {
  type = string
}

data "braintrust_project_group" "team" {
  org_id = var.org_id
  name   = "Application team"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the project group to look up.
- `org_id` (String) Organization the project group belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Date of project group creation.
- `deleted_at` (String) Date of project group deletion, or null if the project group is still active.
- `description` (String) Textual description of the project group.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the project group (UUID).
- `member_projects` (Set of String) IDs of projects in this project group.
- `user_id` (String) Identifies the user who created the project group.
